title: Iron Foundations
description: Lower body with goblet squats, curtsy lunges and single-leg deadlifts, finished with full core work

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Moderate high knees
exercises.instructions: Knees to chest at a moderate pace

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm toward the sky

exercises.name: Goblet squat (no weight)
exercises.instructions: Hands in front of the chest, lower deep

exercises.name: Single-leg deadlift
exercises.instructions: Hinge the torso forward, one leg lifts behind, keep your balance

exercises.name: Hollow hold
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, arms and legs extended above the floor, low back pressed down

exercises.name: V-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift arms and legs together to touch your feet

exercises.name: Crunches
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift the shoulders off, brace the abs

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
